title: Tabular Foundation Models Are Effectively Shallow
abstract: arXiv:2610.13253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In-context-learning Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) are uniquely suited to scenarios with limited resources or privacy constraints, as they solve new tasks without additional training. However, their architecture consists of multiple transformer blocks, resulting in high computational and memory footprints. Meanwhile, traditional alternatives like Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees (GBDTs) remain highly competitive and run efficiently on CPUs, suggesting that tabular tasks may not inherently require deep architectures. This contrast raises a fundamental question: can TFMs be simplified by removing architectural redundancies without sacrificing performance? To answer this, we introduce a closed-form, label-free affine translator that replaces a contiguous window of up to 96% of the blocks, leaving the rest unchanged. Evaluating eight frontier TFMs on 171 classification datasets, we reveal that tabular transformers are vastly overparameter

translated_title: 表格基础模型实际上是浅层的
translated_abstract: 基于上下文学习的表格基础模型（TFMs）特别适用于资源受限或存在隐私约束的场景，因为它们无需额外训练即可解决新任务。然而，其架构由多个 transformer 块组成，导致高昂的计算和内存开销。与此同时，梯度提升决策树（GBDTs）等传统替代方法仍极具竞争力，并且可以在 CPU 上高效运行，这表明表格任务可能本质上并不需要深层架构。这种对比引出了一个根本性问题：能否通过消除架构冗余来简化 TFMs，而不牺牲性能？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了一种闭式、无需标签的仿射转换器，它可以替换连续窗口中高达 96% 的块，而其余部分保持不变。在 171 个分类数据集上对八个前沿 TFMs 进行评估后，我们发现表格 transformer 模型存在严重的参数冗余。
tldr: 表格基础模型（TFMs）实际上是“浅层”的——其 transformer 块中高达 96% 可以被一个闭式、无需标签的仿射转换器替换而不损失性能，说明这类模型存在大量架构冗余，可以被大幅简化。
en_tdlr: Tabular Foundation Models are effectively shallow: up to 96% of their transformer blocks can be replaced by a closed-form, label-free affine translator without sacrificing performance, revealing massive architectural redundancy in these models.
